domestic_evidence: No domestic supply record retrieved. GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender awards and annual-report India sales splits are not public in any page I could open: web_search was unavailable (searx connection refused on every query), thecompanycheck.com returned HTTP 403, volza.com returned HTTP 403. Nothing found either way — not evidence of absence.
note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely declared: dated customs shipping bills with B/L numbers, destination countries (Saudi Arabia, Russia, Uzbekistan) and HS codes 63026010 / 63041910, spanning 2024-03-13 to 2026-02-21. Declared HS in the batch (630260; 630419; 630710) matches the observed codes for 630260 and 630419; no 630710 line was seen in the free view, so that sub-code remains unverified rather than contradicted. Slug variants tried: 'rangoli-furnishings-private-limited' (37 records, used) and 'rangoli-furnishings-pvt-ltd' / 'rangoli-furnishings-pvt-ltd-' (both returned an empty 'Loading...' page with no shipment rows — the abbreviated legal-name form is not indexed, so the 37 records belong to the full-name entity only). Industry claimed as 'food and FMCG' does not match the observed cargo, which is 100% cotton terry towelling, bath sheets, duvet covers and pillow cases — home textiles, not food; the industry label appears to be a data-entry error on the buyer side and should be corrected, but per project rules this is not a rejection ground. Revenue and export volume figures: null — ImportKey free view gives shipment counts, not values, and no financials were accessible. No sanctions/court/ownership checks were performed in this pass (out of scope for the shipments role). Verdict on shipments: real export dispatches exist and are documented; domestic supply trail not established.
